entries.detail: 1 = might, 2 = grace, 3 = wits, 4 = nerve, 5 = signature, 6 = signature
entries.name: Opening roll
entries.text: Rolled stat +1 and another stat of the player's choice -1 (min 1); no change if the rolled stat is already 3. First Threshold = the class opening for that stat.

entries.detail: Was Depth 10, Damage 3. Retuned to keep two-Bargain lethality once running from the Crucible stopped counting as survival.
entries.name: The Crucible
entries.text: Depth 8, Difficulty 2, enemy Damage 2. It opens on Hostile and turns to a different kind after every cast; the new demand shows before the player chooses. There is no exit: Panic 7 costs your next action.

entries.name: Ally die
entries.text: +1 die while an ally is with you: a person met on a Witness Leaf who currently trusts you. One ally at a time. Attack or abandon them and they leave. Pool cap 6 still applies.

entries.detail: Scanner: Relic, Hazard. Battery: Relic. Toolbelt: Hazard, Relic. Lockpicks: Relic. Prayer cords: Witness. Ranged: rifle, pistol. Melee: torch, tool-arm, blade.
entries.name: Gear helps kinds
entries.notes: Rules thread, 2026-10-14. Per-class detail is on each class.
entries.text: An item that helps a chapter's kind adds +1 die and spends a Use. Ranged weapons fight with Grace, melee with Might.

entries.name: Director scope
entries.text: The app's director chooses only how a draw is shown (one dot, two or three shapes, or the dark) and the narrative beat (calm, foreshadow, a clue, a person acting). It never touches casts, deck order or numbers.
